output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount), 2) AS discontinued_revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND p.is_active = false;
output.explanation: Adds up the net line amounts (after discounts, without shipping) for discontinued products (is_active = false). Only lines from completed orders (is_revenue = true) count. The data covers 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, so no date filter is needed.
